description: A provenance-pinned request to stage one fixture twice, run both replay routes in isolated processes, post-attest the fixture trees, and evaluate exact semantic equivalence.

actions.description: Ordered native-v1 move_party actions. Each has exactly one supported string command; the gate enforces zero-based contiguous ordinals and hashes the canonical array into the completed replay profile.

executable.description: Absolute, physical, normalized executable path used for both children.

fixture_manifest_sha256.description: Caller-pinned SHA-256 digest of the exact reviewed manifest bytes. The gate matches it before staging and against the continuously held manifest lease before either child runs.

fixture_tree_sha256.description: Caller-pinned canonical fixture-tree digest. The gate must match it against the continuously pinned manifest and source before staging.

manifest.description: Absolute, physical, normalized path to an existing regular replay-fixture manifest v1 file.

output_slot.description: Destination save slot. The gate enforces that it differs from the manifest's input slot.

rng_seed.description: Deterministic 64-bit RNG seed shared by both children.

rng_stream.description: Deterministic 64-bit RNG stream selector shared by both children.

source_root.description: Absolute, physical, normalized existing source tree governed by the manifest.

title: Realmz semantic replay equivalence request v1
